main_body: raised wooden farm hut with tiled roof
top_band: tiled roof slope from row 0 to row 21 (wood ridge beam rows 0-2, yellow/orange/red-brown roof tiles rows 3-21)
evidence: Rows 0-21 show the foreshortened top/slope of the tiled roof (with wood ridge at 0-2 and tile courses down to 21). Rows 22-23 form a dark eave overhang shadow under the roof, and rows 24-43 show the vertical wooden front wall (set back narrower than the roof), recessed doorway, window, raised platform deck (row 35 light top edge) and stilts.

style.evidence: The roof tiles use the exact same 5-6 step Beodeul ramp (pale yellow crest highlights, orange, terracotta, dark red, deep plum) and per-tile scallop pattern as the reference house-h101_0. The wooden log wall, deck and stilts use a 5-step brown ramp with dark brown material outlines and detailed wood grain texture matching the shed on the reference.
